title: adesso Group is the only firm Camunda-certified across all three DACH countries
content:
adesso Group holds a unique position in the directory: it is the only firm Camunda-certified in all three DACH countries — Gold in Switzerland, Silver in Germany and Austria — and it also appears as a Flowable partner, making it dual across the two process-orchestration platforms the corpus tracks most closely.

Tri-country certification is not just breadth. It means the process-automation practice is organised as a group capability with certified staff in each national market, so the practice can carry a technology across borders instead of trialling it in one office. For a thesis that needs European reach, that is the most valuable structural fact in the cohort.

What holds it at priority 3 is scale: 11,000-plus staff, which the record calls a committee sale. Above a certain size, a technology decision passes through alliance management and architecture review rather than a delivery lead, and the calendar for that process is measured in quarters. So the depth is real and the entry point is expensive — the same tension recorded for the separate adesso SE row, which is filed at priority 9 on scale with Camunda as its stack and no Flowable attribution. Two rows, one group, two tool attributions and two rankings: worth reconciling before either is acted on. Provenance is the Flowable Partner Finder mined on 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
